_comment: Engineering polish pass (pre-Backend-v1.0-review) — Task 3, Dependency Security Validation. Each entry is a `pnpm audit` finding this project has explicitly reviewed and accepted, keyed by its GHSA advisory id (extracted from the finding's own `url` field). scripts/check-audit-allowlist.js compares every CURRENT `pnpm audit --json` finding against this list: anything already here passes quietly (no CI noise for a documented, already-triaged risk); anything NOT here fails the build with a clear message, forcing a real triage decision before it can be ignored. The full reasoning behind each entry lives in docs/architecture/security.md §11/§14 — this file is the machine-checked index into that reasoning, not a duplicate of it. Do not add an entry here without also updating security.md; do not remove an entry without confirming the underlying package/finding is actually gone from `pnpm audit`.
